children: Nomination of Government Nominee Director on the Board of GAIL (India) Limited

This is with reference to Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas (MoP&NG) Letter No. CA-31022/1/2021-CA-PNG(37493) dated 29.09.2026 regarding nomination of  Shri Rajeev Kumar, Deputy Director General, MoP&NG on the Board of the Company for a period of three years or co-terminus basis or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
